name: scholars-attendant
description: Research paper discovery, summarization, figure extraction, and Notion archiving for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Find papers, summarize them, and write to Notion
interface.longDescription: A research reading assistant for Codex that identifies papers from URLs, extracts metadata and figures, writes blog-style Notion pages, and creates Chinese translations.
defaultPrompt: Use $paper-collector on this arXiv link and save it to Notion.
Use $paper-to-notion to write a blog-style page for this paper.
Use $paper-figures to extract figures from this paper.
